title: SHINE v8.1 Finding Schema
description: Canonical finding contract. Every subagent MUST return findings conforming to this schema. The orchestrator REJECTS any non-conforming finding at Stage 5a and writes the rejection to outputs/rejected-findings.log. Schema v8.1 adds: canonical three-field provenance chain, structured location subfields, model+reference version stamps, evergreen_accepted state, regulatory_citation field, and elapsed_seconds telemetry on subagent envelopes.

id.description: Stable ID assigned by orchestrator on ingestion. Format: F-<seq>. Subagent leaves blank; orchestrator populates.

subagent.description: Which subagent produced this finding. Required for merge logic and coverage audit.

subagent_version.description: Version stamp of the subagent that produced this finding. Format: 'mechanical@8.1.0'. Required for audit-trail reproducibility per v8.1 invariant.

prompt_version.description: Hash or version stamp of the subagent's persona prompt. Lets a reviewer reproduce historical reviews. Format: 'sha256:abc12345' or 'v8.1-prompt-rev3'.

reference_versions.description: Version stamps of every reference file the subagent consulted to produce this finding. e.g., {'asc-matrices': '2026-Q2-v1', 'regulatory-corpus/CIMA': '2026-Q2-v1'}.

layer.description: Originating SHINE layer (L1-L14). One layer per finding even if subagent owns multiple layers.

section.description: Human-readable FS location. Format: '[Statement or Note#] - [Sub-topic]'. Examples: 'Note 1 - Organization', 'SCF - Hidden Rows R7-R8', 'SOI - Concentration >5%'.

sortOrder.description: Render sequence within statement group. SAL findings < SOI < SOP < SOC < SCF < Notes (N1 < N2 < ... < NN) < FiHi. Orchestrator may rewrite to enforce canonical ordering.

statement.description: Which face statement or section. MultiStatement is reserved for cross-statement tie-outs (TIE-1 through TIE-10).

severity.description: Per SKILL.md severity classification. Orchestrator may escalate per prior-review matrix unless evergreen_accepted is true.

confidence.description: CERTAIN = mathematically provable. PROBABLE = strong evidence needs confirmation. POSSIBLE = pattern-based suspicion warrants controller question.

state.description: All subagent-returned findings are OPEN. State transitions happen in the dashboard disposition cycle (see SKILL.md Section 'Finding lifecycle').

subagentRaw.description: PROVENANCE FIELD 1 of 3 (v8.1). The original text produced by the subagent. Immutable after Stage 5a validation. Never overwritten by voice normalization or controller edit.

voiceNormalized.description: PROVENANCE FIELD 2 of 3 (v8.1). Populated by orchestrator Stage 5g if voice normalization changed the text. Null if subagentRaw passes voice rules unchanged. Annotation only - controller decides whether this version flows to export.

controllerEdited.description: PROVENANCE FIELD 3 of 3 (v8.1). Populated when the controller edits the finding text in the dashboard. Null until first edit. Subsequent edits overwrite (undo stack preserves history).

text.description: DEPRECATED in v8.1 - retained for backward compatibility. New flow: subagent populates subagentRaw; render layer selects from controllerEdited > voiceNormalized > subagentRaw.

fix.description: Specific corrective action. Quote the offending text where applicable and provide the replacement. Mirrors subagentRaw provenance chain via fixSubagentRaw / fixVoiceNormalized / fixControllerEdited (parallel optional fields).

fixSubagentRaw.description: PROVENANCE for fix text. Original subagent fix. Defaults to value of 'fix' on first ingestion.

fixVoiceNormalized.description: Voice-normalized fix text. Null if no change.

fixControllerEdited.description: Controller-edited fix text. Null until first edit.

location.description: MANDATORY structured location per v8.1. Subagent must populate every applicable sub-field. Schema rejects findings missing location.statement and location.page (or location.cell_ref for Excel-sourced findings).

line_label.description: Specific line label on the statement. e.g., 'Total assets', 'Energy Sector subtotal', 'Investments, at fair value'.

paragraph.description: Paragraph reference within a note. e.g., '¶3', 'first paragraph'.

cell_ref.description: Excel cell reference for L8 findings. e.g., 'SOI!K47'.

quoted_text.description: Verbatim text from the source if applicable. Use UTF-8 characters directly - NEVER unicode escape sequences (per Rule 8).

expected_value.description: What the value should be, if known.

asc_reference.description: ASC paragraph if applicable. e.g., 'ASC 820-10-50-2E'. Mandatory for L9 findings (Stage 5a rejects L9 findings without this field).

regulatory_citation.description: Citation key from reference/regulatory-corpus/ (e.g., 'CIMA:MFA-4', 'CSSF:DEPOSITARY', 'SEC:RULE-206-4-2'). Mandatory for L12 findings (Stage 5a rejects L12 findings without this field). Orchestrator validates citation exists in corpus.

detail.description: Optional expandable computation breakdown or extended reasoning. Renders under 'Detail' toggle in dashboard.

constituent_findings.description: For root-cause findings produced by the reconciler (Stage 5d), this array preserves the original constituent finding IDs that were collapsed. Dashboard exposes via 'Show constituents' toggle.

reconciler_pattern.description: If this finding is a root-cause finding from the reconciler, name of the matching pattern (e.g., 'Pattern 1 - Undisclosed structural change'). Null otherwise.

reconciler_specificity_score.description: Specificity score that selected the matching pattern. Logged in reconciler-decisions.log for audit.

hidden_row_flag.description: True if finding relates to a hidden Excel row (XLSX-7 or XLSX-9 protocol). Triggers 'Hidden Row' dashed gold pill in dashboard.

prior_review_recurrence.description: Cross-review state. NEW = not in prior. RECURRING = was OPEN/ACCEPTED in prior. RESOLVED = was OPEN/ACCEPTED, now absent. REGRESSED = was RESOLVED, now back. EVERGREEN_ACCEPTED (v8.1) = controller previously marked as acceptable practice; skip escalation.

evergreen_accepted.description: v8.1 flag. Controller-set in dashboard to mark a recurring finding as 'acceptable documented practice; do not escalate further.' Prior-review escalation skips findings where this is true. Dashboard displays them but excludes from readiness gate count. Audit trail logs the date and reason.

evergreen_acceptance_reason.description: Required if evergreen_accepted is true. One-line controller justification, logged for audit.

evergreen_acceptance_date.description: ISO-8601 date when evergreen flag was set. Logged for audit.

merge_key.description: Orchestrator-assigned dedup key. Format: '<statement>::<section>::<line_id>::<finding_class>'. Findings sharing a merge_key are candidates for collapse via cross-layer pattern reconciler.

controller_question.description: For PROBABLE/POSSIBLE findings, the specific question to ask the controller. Phrased so controller can answer without re-reading the FS.
